title: Dancing With The Stars Season 35 Halloween Recap: Who Was Eliminated This Spooky Night?
body:
The Halloween episode of “Dancing With The Stars” delivered a dramatic exit on Tuesday night, as one of the remaining Season 35 competitors was eliminated after a night of spooky, horror‑movie‑inspired routines. The themed showdown, which saw the celebrity pairings donning ghoul‑glam costumes and tackling eerie choreography, culminated in a tense judges’ panel and a public vote that sent the contestant packing, intensifying the competition as the series pushes toward its finale.

The night’s performances were a departure from the usual ballroom elegance, with each pair tasked with interpreting classic horror motifs—from haunted mansions to zombie apocalypses—while still adhering to the technical demands of Latin and ballroom styles. Judges Carrie Ann Inaba, Len Goodman, and Bruno Tonioli praised the creativity on display, noting that the Halloween theme pushed the dancers to explore storytelling in new, unsettling ways. However, the judges also highlighted that the eliminated pair struggled to marry the theatrical elements with the precision required for high scores, ultimately falling short of the night’s elevated standards.

Viewer reaction on social media mirrored the intensity of the competition. Fans lauded the bold costuming and the daring choreography, but many expressed surprise at the elimination, arguing that the duo’s previous weeks of steady improvement should have earned them a reprieve. The public vote, which now carries even greater weight as the field narrows, reflected a split between those who value technical merit and those who are swayed by narrative flair and personality. This tension underscores a broader trend on the show: the growing importance of audience engagement in determining outcomes, especially as the series experiments with thematic episodes that blur the line between dance and performance art.

The exit also reshapes the dynamics among the remaining contestants. With one less pair in the mix, the competition intensifies, and the remaining celebrities must now navigate a tighter margin for error. The judges’ feedback suggested that versatility—being able to shift from a romantic waltz to a horror‑infused jive—will be crucial in the upcoming weeks. Moreover, the elimination serves as a reminder that even strong fan bases cannot guarantee safety when the judges’ scores dip below a certain threshold, especially in themed weeks where creative risk is rewarded but also scrutinized.

Industry insiders note that “Dancing With The Stars” has increasingly leaned into special‑event episodes to boost ratings and social buzz, and the Halloween edition appears to have succeeded in both respects. Nielsen reports indicate a modest uptick in viewership compared with the previous week, and trending hashtags related to the show spiked on platforms such as Twitter and TikTok. This strategic programming aligns with the network’s broader push to create event television that encourages live viewing and real‑time interaction, a crucial factor in an era dominated by streaming and on‑demand consumption.

Looking ahead, the remaining contestants will face a series of increasingly challenging themes as the season races toward its climax. The next episode promises a “Broadway Night” showcase, where performers will need to channel the energy of iconic musical numbers while maintaining technical excellence. As the competition tightens, the blend of audience voting power and judges’ critiques will continue to shape the trajectory of the show, setting the stage for a potentially surprise‑filled finale. Fans can expect further dramatic twists, and the stakes have never been higher for those still dancing toward the coveted Mirrorball Trophy.
